The compact muriform brown conidia visible at 50 µm are characteristic of **Alternaria solani**, the causal agent of Early Blight. Among all available classes, Early_Blight is the only one caused by a pathogen that produces this type of muriform, multi-septate, brown conidia. The image credit to Bruce Watt (University of Maine, a region where Early Blight is prevalent) further supports this.
